page: Microsoft Azure L32aos_v4 is a storage and memory-optimized server belonging to the Laosv4 family. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor with an x86_64 architecture, featuring 32 dedicated virtual CPUs and 16 physical cores with 2.0 threads per core. The CPU operates at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz and is equipped with 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. The system includes 256.0 GB of RAM, yielding 8.0 GB of memory per core. It features a massive local storage capacity of 23,038 GB and is Premium Storage capable, running under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-core and multi-core capabilities. The server achieves top 25% performance in stress-ng single-core CPU tests, Geekbench single-core and multi-core scores, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. It also demonstrates strong performance in Geekbench image and text processing, Passmark CPU encryption, and LLM inference speed for small 135M models. Average performance in the middle 50% is observed in stress-ng multi-core CPU tests, memory bandwidth, static web serving throughput, and Redis SET operations.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the L32aos_v4 offers high resource density, combining a substantial memory footprint with exceptionally large local storage capacity on a dedicated AMD EPYC hardware class. This configuration avoids the need for external storage attachments for large datasets, optimizing resource-to-cost ratios for data-intensive operations. The server is configured for large-scale database hosting, data warehousing, memory-intensive analytics, and local file processing workloads.
